title: Revision lets different meanings develop
meaning: Rebuilding inadequate foundations can connect different aspects of understanding and reveal fruitfulness within relationships previously unnoticed together.
text: Fresh possibilities for understanding can open after one simple measure is lost. The Tower in the physical position of Ajna suggests jointly rebuilding a conclusion’s inadequate foundation. Temperance in energy supports connecting different aspects of a question. The Empress in emotions feels new relationships’ fruitfulness. Material can pleasingly retain more connections than an earlier structure allowed. Wanting parts related helps reveal a place for each person’s observation within the inquiry.

Suppose you explained a landscape’s appeal solely through untouched nature. Comparing a favourite view containing a visible road, you release that foundation as sufficient. **Revision can give different aspects of understanding room to develop.** Interest in relationships reveals terrain’s connection with human traces. An impression gains substantial aspects. Seeing a road emphasise distance can feel pleasing. Your view preserves concrete material while each person names a detail. Natural and human-made features gain understandable relationships without declaring every such combination beautiful or harmonious in advance for both people.

The risk is connecting parts only within a pleasing account because possibilities feel abundant. Wanting harmony preserves actual differences. This road emphasised distance while another view may work differently. Your view remains fruitful through attention to material, allowing relationships to develop without automatically justifying everything excluded from an earlier simple explanation of shared preferences.
